linked_not_shipped.name: smoothTalker-sbaitso
linked_not_shipped.license: MIT for the NVDA add-on code
linked_not_shipped.why: The real Dr. Sbaitso / First Byte SmoothTalker voice. It works by running the original 1990 DOS engine file under a CPU emulator. That engine is not open source, so it can't be shipped here.

linked_not_shipped.name: softvoice-sapi5
linked_not_shipped.why: The real 1997 SoftVoice voices for Windows. The engine itself is the original SoftVoice DLL files, which are not open source, so they can't be shipped here.
